name: bitwarden-vault
description: Multi-account Bitwarden password manager with TOTP generation, credential injection, vault search, encrypted export, Gmail OTP auto-fetch, and Secrets Manager (bws) integration

tools.name: bw_status
tools.description: Show Bitwarden vault status for all configured accounts

tools.name: bw_search
tools.description: Search Bitwarden vault items by query

tools.name: bw_totp
tools.description: Generate TOTP code for a Bitwarden item

tools.name: bw_switch
tools.description: Switch active Bitwarden account (personal, work, api)

account.description: Account name: personal, work, or api

tools.name: bw_unlock
tools.description: Unlock Bitwarden vault and print raw session key

tools.name: bw_login
tools.description: Login to the active Bitwarden account

tools.name: bw_export
tools.description: Export Bitwarden vault with optional encryption

account.description: Account to export: personal, work, or api

tools.name: bw_auth_setup
tools.description: Interactive setup: store master passwords, API keys, and Gmail app passwords in macOS Keychain

tools.name: bw_auth_test
tools.description: Test authentication for all configured accounts (auto-login + unlock)

tools.name: bw_auth_show
tools.description: Show stored credentials (masked) for all accounts

tools.name: bw_auth_login
tools.description: Interactive login with OTP support (auto-fetches from Gmail if app password stored)

tools.name: bws_secret_list
tools.description: List secrets from Bitwarden Secrets Manager

tools.name: bws_secret_get
tools.description: Get a specific secret from Bitwarden Secrets Manager

tools.name: bws_secret_create
tools.description: Create a secret in Bitwarden Secrets Manager

tools.name: bws_project_list
tools.description: List projects from Bitwarden Secrets Manager

tools.name: bws_run
tools.description: Run a command with Bitwarden Secrets Manager secrets injected as env vars

command.description: Command to run with secrets injected

tools.name: bws_setup
tools.description: Interactive setup for Bitwarden Secrets Manager credentials (access token + profile)
